name: NGC 4603, SN 2008cn field (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 4603, a nearly face-on spiral galaxy that hosted the Type II-plateau supernova SN 2008cn, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2008cn-hubble
story: A supernova, SN 2008cn, once blazed in this nearly face-on spiral. Hubble returned after its glow had faded, to check whether the star suspected of exploding had vanished.

claims.text: SN 2008cn is a Type II-plateau supernova in NGC 4603
NGC 4603 is a nearly face-on spiral galaxy
The program revisits core-collapse supernova sites after they fade to confirm the progenitors have disappeared; SN 2008cn is one of its targets
